_readme: Decomposition of mortality after an EMC diagnosis into disease deaths and deaths from everything else. Generated by research/manuscripts/emc_mortality_decomposition.py from the cited figures in research/data/emc-clinical-registry.json, which is their one home. READ THE PAIRING FIELD ON EVERY ROW. `within_series` rows pair two figures measured on the same patients and are the only ones that do not cross populations; `cross_series` rows pair an all-cause figure from one study against a disease-specific figure from another and are reported as ranges for that reason. Nothing here asserts efficacy, safety, a therapeutic window or clinical readiness for any intervention, and nothing here is a prognosis.
directional_bias: Disease-specific survival estimated by censoring other-cause deaths overstates the cumulative incidence of disease death under competing risks, so the competing share reported here is an UNDER-estimate. The bias runs against this analysis's own conclusion, which is why the subtraction is publishable at all.

direct_cause_split.label: Japanese national registry, localised surgical
direct_cause_split.estimator: Direct ratio of two death counts on the same patients. No survival curve, no cross-population pairing, no subtraction of summary percentages.
direct_cause_split.what_still_limits_it: Follow-up is finite and shorter than this disease's natural history, so both counts are censored -- and they are NOT censored equally. EMC deaths keep accruing for decades while competing deaths accrue immediately, so a short follow-up flatters the competing share early and the disease share late. This is a reading at the study's own horizon, not a lifetime split.
direct_cause_split.pairing_note: ⭐ The cleanest pairing in this file. Both cause counts come from the same patients under the same ascertainment, so the competing share is a ratio of two counts rather than a subtraction of percentages from different studies. Localised stratum: 9 tumour deaths (8 in the no-chemotherapy arm plus 1 in the chemotherapy arm) and 4 other-cause deaths, over a median 38 months.

direct_cause_split.pairing_note: Same study, advanced stratum: 9 tumour deaths (5 in the advanced-chemotherapy arm plus 4 in the arm that did not receive it) and 1 other-cause death. ⚠ The competing share is much lower here than in the localised stratum, and that is exactly what it should be -- these patients are dying of EMC faster, so the disease outruns their other causes.

within_series.label: Meis-Kindblom 1999 pathology series
within_series.estimator_mismatch: The all-cause figure is a survival-curve reading at the horizon; the disease-specific figure is a crude proportion over the whole follow-up. They are not the same estimator and this decomposition is approximate.
within_series.pairing_note: The only series in the registry that reports BOTH a long-horizon all-cause survival curve and a disease-specific death count on the same patients. The two are not on the same estimator -- 70% is a survival-curve reading at 10 years, 18/99 is a crude proportion over a median 108-month follow-up -- so the within-series decomposition below is approximate and is reported as such. It is still the only decomposition that does not cross populations.

excluded_pairings.how_to_read_them: These are not outliers to be trimmed. Each one is a cross-series pairing demonstrating that the two studies it joins cannot describe a single population, which is the honest limit of every figure in this section. A horizon where most pairings are impossible should not be quoted at all.

background_mortality_check.life_table_source: WHO Global Health Observatory, indicator LIFE_0000000029, USA, 2021
background_mortality_check.reading: A ratio near 1 means the gap is ordinary background mortality and the decomposition is sound. A ratio far above 1 means the gap is larger than age and sex explain, which points at study non-comparability rather than at patients dying of other causes -- in that case the decomposition is an artifact and must not be quoted.

horizon_matched_background_check.reading: A ratio near 1 means the non-EMC deaths in this cohort are what ordinary background mortality produces, so the competing share is a real reading rather than an artifact of incomparable studies. A ratio far above 1 would mean the opposite and would make every competing-share figure here unquotable.
horizon_matched_background_check.⚠: This rests on 4 event(s). The interval is wide and the point estimate is not precise -- what the check establishes is CONSISTENCY with background, never equality to it.

reading_guide.antitumour_ceiling: The percentage points of survival at the horizon that a therapy preventing EVERY EMC death would add. It is an upper bound on this repository's entire sixty-eight-route portfolio taken together, not on any one route.
reading_guide.competing_share_of_deaths: Of the patients dead at the horizon, the fraction who did not die of EMC. No route on the board is aimed at this fraction.
reading_guide.what_it_does_not_say: That competing deaths are preventable. Establishing that requires naming a specific cause and a specific intervention with a measured effect, which is a separate question and a separate artifact.
